item.name: PUBLIC API — Banking Platform Integration (SDK Demo)

header.description: Banking platform API key for TokenShield integration

request.description:
Primary integration endpoint for any external banking platform. Send any payment request through this — engine returns threat_score, action (allow/challenge/block), signals breakdown, and explainability narrative.

Integration pattern:
1. Bank intercepts payment request
2. Calls POST /api/v1/analyze
3. If action=='allow' → proceed payment
4. If action=='challenge' → trigger 2FA/step-up auth
5. If action=='block' → reject + log incident
Call this when user logs in to your banking platform. Establishes the legitimate baseline for geo, device, and behavioral signals.
Poll current threat level for any session. Useful for real-time risk dashboard in your banking portal.
Immediately blacklists a session across all Redis caches and engine state. Call this when your banking system detects any fraud signal independently.
Use for uptime monitoring. Should respond <50ms. Check models field to verify all 3 ML models (IF/LSTM/Meta) are loaded.
